Unresolved information

  • Per-specimen synthesis batches and complete links between nominal feed doping and measured incorporation are not given.
  • Several workup volumes, separation hardware, stirring speed, aging times, TOPO/powder ratio and exact purification cycles are unreported.
  • No measured atomic coordinate file, sample-specific refined dopant occupancy, raw spectral array or full statistical error model is supplied.

Source distinctions and conflicts

  • The text uses inconsistent 4T1(P)/4T2(P) labels for some Co multiplet references; original equations, captions and discussion are retained without changing measured line positions.
